method: Each provider's token counter (Gemini countTokens, Anthropic count_tokens, OpenAI responses/input_tokens) on the app's four prompts, a filler answer and 6,000 characters of English prose; images are JPEG at quality 80. charsPerToken is rounded down from the lowest measured ratio, so estimates run high and history is trimmed early rather than late.

image.note: The same at 768, 1024 and 2048 px long edge: the count depends only on mediaResolution.
width x height / 750 is within 5% of the count up to 2048x1536, and above it.
Not the tile rule the design expected: about 1.2 tokens per 32x32 patch, with detail high capped near 2,942 tokens. Provisional; measured again with the OpenAI client in Phase 2.
